description: Extends F1a resonance model with PTO power limit (rated capacity), seawater density correction, PTO efficiency vs power level, and survival threshold (storm cutout).

eta_pto_rated.description: PTO efficiency at rated load (linear generator optimal operating point)

eta_pto_min.description: PTO efficiency at very low power (linear generator part-load)

P_rated_kw.description: Rated (maximum) electrical output before PTO limiting

H_s_cutout.description: Storm cutout significant wave height; device shuts down above this

H_s_cutin.description: Minimum H_s for positive net power (below this, efficiency too low)

pto_partload_coeff.description: PTO efficiency reduction at zero power (linear interpolation: eta(P) = eta_rated - coeff*(1-P/P_rated))

source: Falnes (2002); Babarit et al. (2012) Renew. Energy 41:44-63; CorPower Ocean datasheet (2020); Eriksson et al. (2005) Renew. Sustain. Energy Rev. 9:435.
